items.brief: Tokenized commodities look beyond gold as lending and oil open new markets

items.brief: Visa survey says nearly half of APAC consumers open to using stablecoins by 2031
items.why: Signals growing stablecoin payment demand, though understanding remains low.

items.brief: Base creator says equities and non-dollar stablecoins will lead tokenization supercycle
items.why: Points to tokenized stocks and non-dollar stablecoins as growth drivers.

items.brief: XRP Ledger adds new controls for banks, stablecoins and tokenized funds
items.why: Gives institutions granular account controls for tokenized asset custody.

items.why: Tokenized equities with dividend and voting rights expand onchain market access.

items.why: Major institutional investment in tokenized money market fund shares.

items.brief: IMF warns tokenized markets could amplify financial risks
items.why: Highlights liquidity and volatility concerns for tokenized equity markets.

items.brief: Samsung to launch USDC transfers on Solana for US Galaxy users
items.why: Brings USDC transfers into Samsung Wallet with fiat on- and off-ramps.
